opinions: CORPORATE OPPRESSION IS OFTEN MORE PERVASIVE AND SUBTLE, THUS REQUIRING MORE ATTENTION THAN GOVERNMENTAL OPPRESSION.

ENSURING WELFARE FOR ALL CITIZENS IS MORE CRITICAL THAN MAINTAINING A BALANCED BUDGET.
PUBLICLY-FUNDED RESEARCH FOSTERS INNOVATION AND BENEFITS SOCIETY MORE THAN MARKET-DRIVEN RESEARCH.
